name: scale_x_angle_hvel
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral offset, body tilt, and horizontal velocity to counter strong wind and higher gravity, encouraging more aggressive side‑engine usage and attitude correction.

name: scale_ang_vel
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to angular velocity (body rotation rate) to improve attitude correction under strong wind, helping keep the lander upright and reducing crash rate.

name: scale_all_critical
hypothesis: Amplify all key state dimensions (horizontal offset, height, horizontal/vertical velocities, body angle, angular velocity) to increase sensitivity to wind and stronger gravity, encouraging earlier thrust and better attitude control under the compound physics.

name: scale_height_vert_vel
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to height and vertical velocity (and keep strong scaling for horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, and body angle) to trigger earlier main engine thrust under stronger gravity and to better control descent speed.

name: scale_ang_vel_main_offset
hypothesis: Combine increased sensitivity to angular velocity and angle with a positive bias for the main engine logit to trigger earlier and stronger vertical thrust under higher gravity and wind.

name: scale_height_vert_vel_ang_vel
hypothesis: Amplify height, vertical velocity, body angle, and angular velocity (along with horizontal offset and velocity) to make the policy react earlier to descent speed and attitude errors under stronger gravity and wind.

name: scale_x_angle_main_bias_0.1
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, and body angle, and add a small positive bias to the main engine logit to encourage earlier thrust under stronger gravity and wind.

name: scale_x_angle_ang_vel_main_offset_0.4
hypothesis: Combine the input scaling that helped (increase sensitivity to horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, body angle, angular velocity) with a larger positive bias on the main engine logit to fire the main engine earlier and stronger under higher gravity and wind.

name: scale_x_vel_ang_vel_main_side_bias
hypothesis: Amplify horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, height, vertical velocity, body angle, and especially angular velocity to make the policy react more strongly to wind and attitude errors, and add positive biases to the side‑engine and main‑engine logits (and a slight negative bias to the off action) to encourage earlier and more frequent thrust under stronger gravity and wind.

name: scale_ang_vel_main_side_bias_small
hypothesis: Scale horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, body angle, and angular velocity (to improve wind and attitude response) and add modest biases to encourage any thrust (off slightly discouraged, side engines slightly encouraged, main engine more encouraged) to fire earlier under higher gravity and wind.

name: scale_all_bias_strong
hypothesis: Amplify all state dimensions (horizontal offset, height, horizontal/vertical velocities, body angle, angular velocity) to make the policy more responsive to strong wind and higher gravity, and add a negative bias to the off action and positive biases to side and main engines to encourage earlier and more frequent thrust.

name: scale_x_angle_hvel_side_bias
hypothesis: Keep the input scaling that improved performance (increase sensitivity to horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, and body angle) and add a negative bias to the off action and positive biases to the side‑engine actions to encourage earlier side‑engine thrust against strong wind.
